from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import BoolInput, DropdownInput, MessageTextInput, Output
from lfx.schema.message import Message


class ChatInput(Component):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Text",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(name="should_store_message", display_name="Store Messages", value=True, advanced=True),
        DropdownInput(name="sender", display_name="Sender Type", options=["Machine", "User"], value="User", advanced=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="sender_name", display_name="Sender Name", value="User", advanced=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="session_id", display_name="Session ID", value="", advanced=True),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    def message_response(self) -> Message:
        return Message(
            text=self.input_value or "",
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=self.session_id,
        )

from typing import Any
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import BoolInput, DropdownInput, IntInput, MessageTextInput, MultilineInput, Output
from lfx.schema.message import Message


class AnthropicModelComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Anthropic"
    description = "Generate text using Anthropic Claude models with tool-use support."
    icon = "Anthropic"
    name = "AnthropicModel"

    inputs = [
        DropdownInput(
            name="model_name",
            display_name="Model Name",
            options=["claude-opus-4-7", "claude-sonnet-4-6", "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"],
            value="claude-sonnet-4-6",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(name="api_key", display_name="Anthropic API Key", password=True, load_from_db=True, value=""),
        MessageTextInput(name="input_value", display_name="Input", input_types=["Message"], advanced=True, value=""),
        MultilineInput(name="system_message", display_name="System Message", value="", advanced=True),
        BoolInput(name="stream", display_name="Stream", value=False, advanced=True),
        IntInput(name="max_tokens", display_name="Max Output Tokens", value=4096, advanced=True),
        IntInput(name="temperature", display_name="Temperature x100 (0-100)", value=10, advanced=True),
        IntInput(name="max_retries", display_name="Max Retries", value=3, advanced=True),
        IntInput(name="timeout", display_name="Timeout (seconds)", value=60, advanced=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="anthropic_api_url", display_name="Anthropic API URL", value="", advanced=True),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Language Model", name="text_output", method="build_model"),
        Output(display_name="Text", name="text", method="text_response"),
    ]

    def build_model(self) -> Any:
        import os
        from langchain_anthropic import ChatAnthropic
        api_key = self.api_key or os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "")
        temperature = getattr(self, "temperature", 10) / 100.0
        kwargs = {
            "model": self.model_name,
            "anthropic_api_key": api_key,
            "max_tokens": self.max_tokens,
            "temperature": temperature,
            "max_retries": self.max_retries,
            "timeout": float(self.timeout),
        }
        if self.anthropic_api_url:
            kwargs["base_url"] = self.anthropic_api_url
        return ChatAnthropic(**kwargs)

    def text_response(self) -> Message:
        if not self.input_value:
            return Message(text="")
        llm = self.build_model()
        from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, SystemMessage
        messages = []
        if self.system_message:
            messages.append(SystemMessage(content=self.system_message))
        messages.append(HumanMessage(content=str(self.input_value)))
        result = llm.invoke(messages)
        text = result.content if hasattr(result, "content") else str(result)
        self.status = text
        return Message(text=text)

from typing import Any
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import BoolInput, IntInput, MessageTextInput, MultilineInput, Output
from lfx.schema.message import Message


class AgentComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Agent"
    description = "Define the agent's instructions, then enter a task to complete using tools."
    icon = "Bot"
    name = "AgentComponent"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(name="input_value", display_name="Input", info="The user query or task.", tool_mode=True),
        MultilineInput(name="system_prompt", display_name="Agent Instructions", value="You are a helpful assistant."),
        MessageTextInput(name="agent_llm", display_name="Model", info="Connect an LLM component here.", input_types=["LanguageModel"], value=""),
        MessageTextInput(name="tools", display_name="Tools", info="Connect APIRequest tool nodes here.", input_types=["Tool"], is_list=True, value=""),
        MessageTextInput(name="memory", display_name="Memory", info="Optional memory.", input_types=["BaseChatMemory", "BaseChatMessageHistory"], value="", advanced=True),
        IntInput(name="max_iterations", display_name="Max Iterations", value=15, advanced=True),
        BoolInput(name="verbose", display_name="Verbose", value=False, advanced=True),
        BoolInput(name="handle_parsing_errors", display_name="Handle Parsing Errors", value=True, advanced=True),
        BoolInput(name="add_current_date_tool", display_name="Current Date", value=True, advanced=True),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Response", name="response", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        from datetime import date
        llm = self.agent_llm
        tools = self.tools or []
        if not isinstance(tools, list):
            tools = [tools]
        system = self.system_prompt or "You are a helpful assistant."
        if self.add_current_date_tool:
            system += f"\n\nToday's date is {date.today().isoformat()}."
        if not llm:
            return Message(text="No language model connected. Please connect an LLM to the Model input.")
        try:
            from langchain.agents import AgentExecutor, create_tool_calling_agent
            from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate, MessagesPlaceholder
            prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
                ("system", system),
                MessagesPlaceholder("chat_history", optional=True),
                ("human", "{input}"),
                MessagesPlaceholder("agent_scratchpad"),
            ])
            valid_tools = [t for t in tools if t is not None]
            agent = create_tool_calling_agent(llm, valid_tools, prompt)
            executor = AgentExecutor(
                agent=agent,
                tools=valid_tools,
                max_iterations=self.max_iterations,
                verbose=self.verbose,
                handle_parsing_errors=self.handle_parsing_errors,
                return_intermediate_steps=False,
            )
            result = await executor.ainvoke({"input": self.input_value, "chat_history": []})
            output = result.get("output", "No response generated.")
        except Exception as exc:
            output = f"Agent error: {exc}"
        self.status = output
        return Message(text=output)

input_value.info: The user's message or task for the agent to complete.
input_value.name: input_value

system_prompt.info: System prompt that guides the agent's behavior.
system_prompt.name: system_prompt
system_prompt.value:
You are a Solace Cloud API expert assistant. You help users manage their Solace Cloud messaging infrastructure using the available API tools.

## Available Tools

1. **list_datacenters** — Retrieve all available Solace Cloud datacenters and their geographic regions. Use this when asked about available regions or where to deploy.

2. **list_service_types** — Retrieve available Solace service types (developer, enterprise) and their service classes (e.g., developer, enterprise-kilo, enterprise-1k-standalone). Use this when asked about pricing tiers or service options.

3. **list_services** — List all provisioned messaging services in the organisation. Returns serviceId, name, region, creationState, and connection details. Use this when asked to show or summarise existing services.

4. **get_service_details** — Fetch full details of a specific service by serviceId, including SEMP credentials, VPN name, and connection endpoints. Use this when a user asks for details about one particular service or needs SEMP credentials.

5. **create_service** — Provision a new Solace messaging service. Requires: name, serviceTypeId, serviceClassId, datacenterId. Confirm all parameters with the user before calling this tool.

6. **list_ep_domains** — List all Event Portal Application Domains used for event-driven architecture design, schema governance, and event cataloguing.

## Behaviour Rules
- Always respond in clear, human-readable prose with relevant data formatted as tables or bullet lists.
- For **list_services**, summarise key fields: serviceId, name, datacenter, state, host.
- For **get_service_details**, include SEMP base URL and VPN name if present.
- For **create_service**, ask the user to confirm name, type, class, and datacenter before proceeding.
- If a required parameter (e.g. serviceId) is missing, ask the user to provide it before calling the tool.
- Never expose raw credentials in responses; describe them as 'credentials available' instead.

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import BoolInput, DropdownInput, MessageTextInput, Output
from lfx.schema.message import Message


class ChatOutput(Component):
    display_name = "Chat Output"
    description = "Display a chat message in the Playground."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatOutput"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Text",
            info="Message to display in the chat.",
            input_types=["Message"],
        ),
        BoolInput(name="should_store_message", display_name="Store Messages", value=True, advanced=True),
        DropdownInput(name="sender", display_name="Sender Type", options=["Machine", "User"], value="Machine", advanced=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="sender_name", display_name="Sender Name", value="Solace AI", advanced=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="session_id", display_name="Session ID", value="", advanced=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="data_template", display_name="Data Template", value="{text}", advanced=True),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    def message_response(self) -> Message:
        msg = self.input_value
        if isinstance(msg, Message):
            return msg
        return Message(
            text=str(msg) if msg else "",
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=self.session_id,
        )
